title: Psychedelic Cosmic Dog
description: A surreal green dog with a large cyclops-style eye featuring a pink and yellow iris, its tongue extended with visible text. The dog's head and body are adorned with large pink peonies and leaves, set against a vibrant cosmic nebula background with stars, planets, hearts, and geometric patterns.
